_meta.description: Crosstab count of from_tier x to_tier (one row per member-month move: each member's tier before and after) decorated with an OVERLAY_SYMMETRY matrix-scope overlay: Bowker's test of symmetry (McNemar's on a 2 x 2, where params.correct toggles the continuity correction) asks whether members moved between each pair of tiers as often one way as back. The scalar payload is the chi-square; the summary carries the p-value, df (the tier pairs with at least one move), the number of members who changed tier and the dropped empty pairs. A pair with fewer than 10 moves raises one PULSE_OVERLAY_EXPECTED_LOW warning. Rows and columns align by tier name (implicit-margin contract; no ref pointer).
_meta.name: crosstab-symmetry
